# `mise bootstrap accounts status`

- **用法：** `mise bootstrap accounts status [-J --json] [--missing]`
- **效果：** 只读
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/bootstrap.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/bootstrap.rs)

Show the state of the configured Linux users and groups

## Flags
- **`-J --json`** — Output in JSON format
- **`--missing`** — Exit with status 1 if any account differs from the config (all are still listed)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
